First is Open Higgs Field, which replaces Higgs Field and lets you generate AI images
and cinematic videos. Second is Voice Studio, which replaces 11 labs and lets you generate
and clone voices right on your local machine. Third is Open SEO, which replaces SEM Rush
and lets you do Rank Tracking, Backlinks, and Site Audits all in one place.
Fourth is App Flowey, which replaces Notion and lets you write Notes and Docs,
and it works with local models. Fifth is Open Whisper, which replaces Whisper Flow and lets
you dictate into any app, online or offline. Sixth is Open Project, which replaces Asana
and lets you manage your tasks and projects. Seventh is Cal.com, which replaces Calendly
and lets you book meetings, and it syncs with Google and Outlook. Eighth is Chat Woot,
which replaces Intercom and puts every lead and client message into one inbox.
And ninth is Cap, which replaces Loom and lets you record your screen.
